confidence_rationale: All scores derived from direct evidence in S726 agent output files, CURRENT_BASELINES.md, enforcement certification report, session summary, and ownership registry. Governance guard upgrade confirmed by test results (27/27 PASS). Phantom remediation confirmed by CURRENT_BASELINES.md read-back (9/9 remediated, 0 phantom DL-008 in §3). Ownership acceptance state confirmed by registry (Agent I, 0/6). Simulations confirmed by direct clause citation (Agents K-N, confidence 90-95%). Risk register confirmed by 32-item audit (Agent S). Cross-reference verification confirmed by manual document scan (Agent F, 25 references). Lower-confidence areas: (1) whether the governance guard's string-aware brace-matching handles all Pack D edge cases (disputed DL-008 count unresolved — needs AM-1 verification per Agent C §5.5), and (2) whether the 0/6 ownership acceptance state will change before S727 (governance framework cannot enforce human decision to accept).

methodology_notes.weighting: Detection (25%), Enforcement (25%), Maintenance (20%), Ownership (15%), Portfolio Integrity (15%)
methodology_notes.evidence_standard: All scores cross-referenced against minimum 2 independent S726 agent output files. No score derived from a single self-reported claim (per AGENTS.md §5).
methodology_notes.scoring_distinction: Design maturity (specification completeness) and activation maturity (operational enforcement) are scored separately within each dimension. The composite score weights both equally (50% design, 50% activation). The 24-point design-activation gap is the primary governance risk metric.
